units.source_text: 从前有神佛参加时，也曾把童男童女左右的小侍从，比作观音和势至二尊菩萨。

en.t: In earlier times, when gods and Buddhas took part, the young attendants standing to the left and right of the boy and girl were also likened to the two bodhisattvas Kannon and Seishi.

units.source_text: 还曾让童男童女接受神位，比喻童男童女与神举行婚礼。

en.t: They were also once made to receive divine rank, symbolizing the boy and girl holding a wedding ceremony with the deity.
